params.1274: You need some feathers, regular logs and bronze bars.
params.1275: You can smith arrowheads out of metal bars.
params.1276: Click on the logs (with a knife in your tool belt) to create arrow shafts.
params.1277: Use the feathers on the arrow shafts to create headless arrows.
params.1278: Use the headless arrows with the arrowheads to finish your arrows.
params.2225: The components for arrows will stack in your inventory, so you may wish to prepare plenty of arrow shafts, feather and heads to create all at once.
